//: MONOREPO DEV HARNESS - NOT PART OF THIS TEMPLATE. This file is deliberately absent from frontx-template.json's ownershipBoundaries, so `frontx add` never copies it into a project and this template claims no root package.json anywhere. It follows template-mfe/package.json: the workspaces are this template's MFE packages, and the overrides redirect the pins this repository can offer a local source for (template-shell and its packages/*) to that source, so the packages' tests run in place against the shell they are written for. Every other pin, @gears-frontx/ui-kit and @gears-frontx/api included, resolves from the registry exactly as in a project. template-shell must be built first (`npm ci && npm run build` inside template-shell), because an MFE's vite and vitest configs load the shell's build plugin and test utilities from its build output. The devDependencies serve `dev:reference` only: until the last screen has moved into a package, the former standalone application under src/ stays on disk, unclaimed, and `npm run dev:reference` runs it next to the composed shell for side-by-side checks. They leave together with src/. The nwsapi override carries template-mfe's reason: jsdom's CSS-matching engine regressed in 2.2.26 and 2.2.27, and this harness shares the same jsdom chain.
name: frontx-template-inbox-monorepo-harness
